_comment: Skill Repo Spec v1 s9 -- every path in this repo belongs to exactly one class.
FIXTURE = lifelike test data, must be produced by tools/make_fixtures.py.
DATA    = anything a real run produced. Never git-tracked; resolved out-of-repo by tools/datadir.py.
data_sealed = a path that HELD real data, was purged, and must stay dead.
Enforced by tools/data_boundary.py in .githooks and CI.
_audited: 2026-07-31 RE-AUDIT (confirms the 2026-07-20 sweep). ANSWER: NO. llmcall is a stdlib-only codex->cc->claude call primitive. Its only writes are tempfile.mkstemp files for codex stdin/stdout, created in the OS temp dir and unlinked after use; nothing is appended, cached or journalled anywhere, in this repo or outside it. Tests use synthetic placeholders only. This is the one repo in the fleet whose empty declaration is empty because there is genuinely nothing to declare, rather than because the output lives somewhere else.
